equivalent_claims.content: In graph classification on the MUTAG dataset, the GCN model attains a mean accuracy of 83.54% with a standard deviation of 0.40 using 4.8 thousand parameters, whereas the QGCN model attains a mean accuracy of 88.61% with a standard deviation of 0.66 using 4.4 thousand parameters.

For node classification on OGBN-Arxiv, GCN reaches a mean accuracy of 72.8% with a standard deviation of 1.5 using 145.1 thousand parameters, while QGCN reaches a mean accuracy of 72.3% with a standard deviation of 1.6 using 43.5 thousand parameters.

In link prediction on OGBG-COLLAB, QGCN yields a Hits@50 score of 45.80 with a standard deviation of 1.35 using 6.4 thousand parameters, relative to GCN's Hits@50 score of 44.02 with a standard deviation of 1.57 using 12.5 thousand parameters.
For node classification on Cora, the real GCN reports an accuracy of 85.2 ± 1.3 with 140.5K parameters, while QGCN reports an accuracy of 84.1 ± 1.5 with 42.1K parameters.
In node classification on PubMed, GCN achieves an accuracy of 79.1 ± 1.2 with 131.9K parameters, whereas QGCN achieves an accuracy of 78.4 ± 1.4 with 41.7K parameters.
For link prediction on CORA, GCN obtains a ROC-AUC of 79.27 ± 0.47 with 96.0K parameters, while QGCN obtains a ROC-AUC of 83.55 ± 0.03 with 27.2K parameters.
